import os

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Requête pour les stations de mesure des précipitations

# Charger les données des stations
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Charger les limites du pays

cbar = plt.colorbar(plt.cm.ScalarMappable(norm=norm, cmap='Blues'), ax=ax)

import os
import geopandas as gpd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

engine = create_engine(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])

# Charger gouvernorats avec région naturelle depuis PostGIS
gdf_gov = gpd.read_postgis(
    'SELECT lib_fr, region_naturelle, geom FROM gouvernorats',
    engine, geom_col='geom'
)

# Mapping officiel DGRE : 6 régions naturelles
REGION_COLORS = {
    'Nord Ouest': '#1a9850',
    'Nord Est':   '#66bd63',
    'Centre Ouest': '#fee08b',
    'Centre Est':   '#fdae61',
    'Sud Ouest':    '#f46d43',
    'Sud Est':      '#d73027',
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 14))

for region, color in REGION_COLORS.items():
    subset = gdf_gov[gdf_gov['region_naturelle'] == region]
    if not subset.empty:
        subset.plot(ax=ax, color=color, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

# Légende
patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=r) for r, c in REGION_COLORS.items()]
ax.legend(handles=patches, loc='lower left', fontsize=9,
          title='Régions Naturelles', title_fontsize=10,
          framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='black')

# Labels gouvernorats
for idx, row in gdf_gov.iterrows():
    centroid = row['geom'].centroid
    ax.annotate(row['lib_fr'], xy=(centroid.x, centroid.y),
                fontsize=6, ha='center', va='center',
                fontweight='bold', color='#222222',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', fc='white', alpha=0.6, ec='none'))

ax.set_title('Délimitation des 6 Régions Naturelles de la Tunisie',
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_axis_off()
ax.set_aspect('equal')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output_isohyete.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
